title: DOWNED HITS FOLLOW DAMAGE CUTS
why: Hits on a downed pillager ignored the kid, demo and easy damage cuts and always removed 3 seconds. The base stays 3 seconds in normal career. The current demo dial stays 1, following the later unify1 ruling. Watch in playtest: shoot a downed partner with kid mode or easy mode on and confirm the smaller timer loss leaves time to finish a revive in either window. Sim uses the same rule. No world generation or random draw changes.
now: Downed hits follow the same damage factors as standing hits.

edits.replacement: p.downT-=3*_hitMul*CFG.eDmg*easyDmgMul(); blip('hit');   // v28.xx (cw-cx-downcuts): the standing damage factors also cut the base 3 seconds, in live play and sim.
